subset_proof_chain.claim: Native tokenize_map emits exactly one token per raw map_save.traj_pos row; cached TRAIN tokenized_map is loaded as rows, not duplicated.
InitDiffusion square path calls map_encoder(tokenized_map, tokenized_agent, return_local=False).
square_map_mask returns one Boolean per input row; all map tensors are indexed with dist_mask before attention.

For >1 layers returned context is x_pt[mask]; for1 layer target nodes are x_pt[mask]; for0 square layers rows are also indexed by mask. The map-type mask only retains types4/5; attention changes features, never creates map rows.
Initial map context is again indexed by square keep mask; lane_embed changes channels without duplicating rows.
Cached ego-local map context uses Boolean keep mask on position. EMA/raw feature caches reuse the same rows.
map_tokens count is bincount(map_feature.batch) for each scene, i.e. number of returned filtered rows, not attention edge count.

conclusion: For current count_lane_source=map_tokens and square50 paths, per-scene post-crop count <= per-scene raw token count. No path above appends or duplicates map rows.
